name: Chaos Engine
author: Paycei
description: Makes every mode less predictable: telegraphed hazards rain on the arena, bosses arrive with a camera punch and slow motion, wave mode's shop sells a Stabilizer, the roguelite offers an Entropy patch, survival gets a Chaos Storm event, and outlasting hazards earns a mod achievement. Shows spawn.hazard, camera, time, register.shopItem, register.patch, register.survivalEvent, register.advancement and register.command.
